title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1995 17.11.3 There had been a steady trend in the incidence of cases registered under Prevention of Corruption Act by the Central Bureau of Investigation during the years 1991 to 1995. During 1995, CBI have taken 297 persons under custody for various offences under PC Act. Enforcement by the States/UTs on this account shows that the years 1992 to 1993 had seen a slight fall in the cases registered under PC Act, followed by a marginal increase in 1994. The cases reported in 1995 were less than the cases registered in 1994 but more persons were arrested (2,604) under this act in 1995.
